title: Two Days with the Culprit
notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Conan, Kogoro Mouri, Ran, Inspector Megure, Takagi, Chiba, Professor Agasa) omitted by convention. No `event` node type: every action is a directly typed edge between the entities involved. Per the 2026-08 batch-8+ scoping change, temporal fields (order/temporal_frame/years_before_present) are omitted entirely. The old cases/ file already had the correct culprit (Kanda, vice president) and the right two-gun mechanic in outline, but modeled everything as generic event/knows/was_used_in scaffolding with only 4 person nodes; this rebuild adds the two bystanders present at the mall kidnapping (Kayoko, her mother Natsumi), makes Momoko's and Kanayama's red-herring motives and Momoko's unwitting role in forwarding Kanda's gun-sale website explicit as edges, splits the single 'gun' object into the five distinct physical items the transcript actually tracks (Oomine's purchased gun/blanks, Kanda's website, Kanda's live-round murder weapon, the window-washing machine that carried the discarded gun to the roof, and the separate exploded gun fragment from the basement shooting that bloodied Kanda's hand), and adds real relationship/has_motive_against edges for both red herrings (Kanayama: unpaid wages; Momoko: romantic rejection) plus Oomine's own has_motive_against Onda (blackmail/debt rage) even though he isn't the murderer. case_type: murder.
